python_json_dumps.message0: JSON text from %1 characters %2 indentation %3 keys %4
python_json_dumps.tooltip: Serialize a Python value to JSON text. Unsupported values raise TypeError.

python_json_loads.tooltip: Parse JSON text, bytes, or bytearray. Malformed input raises JSONDecodeError.

python_json_read_file.tooltip: Read and parse one UTF-8 JSON file while preserving file and decode exceptions.

python_json_write_file.message0: write UTF-8 JSON file %1 value %2 characters %3 indentation %4 keys %5
python_json_write_file.tooltip: Serialize a value to a UTF-8 JSON file. I/O and serialization exceptions propagate.

python_json_is_valid.tooltip: Return false only for malformed JSON or invalid encoded bytes; unsupported types still raise TypeError.

python_json_object_get.tooltip: Read a dictionary key and return the default when the key is absent.

python_json_object_set.tooltip: Assign a value to a dictionary key. Mapping and key errors propagate.
